messages.subject: Re: RHIPE on Ubuntu
parts:
The valid download is in github downloads.
From the file it seems it cannot find protobuf nor rhipe devel libraries. For the latter install R as a shared library

On May 27, 2012 3:30 PM, "Jeroen Ooms" <jeroe...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hey Saptarshi,

I am rather new to Hadoop and RHIPE and I am trying to install RHIPE on Ubuntu. However I am getting stuck with the installation. The download link on your website seems dead, but I assume the R package is contained on the /code/R/ dir of the github repo?

So installed libprotobuf-dev and hadoop from this ppa: Ubuntu PPA. Things seem to be there:

jeroen@jeroen-ubuntu:~$ whereis hadoop
hadoop: /usr/bin/hadoop /etc/hadoop /usr/lib/hadoop /usr/bin/X11/hadoop /usr/share/hadoop /usr/share/man/man1/hadoop.1.gz

jeroen@jeroen-ubuntu:~$ whereis libprotobuf
libprotobuf: /usr/lib/libprotobuf.a /usr/lib/libprotobuf.so

HADOOP=/usr/lib/hadoop
export HADOOP

However, when installing your package, I get the attached output (out2.txt).

Any guess to how I should get things to work?

Thank you very much,

Jeroen
